chapter: La Vida and Handy's own bands
title: Drinking to play
summary: Handy admits he could only play when drinking and bought whiskey on credit.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Didn't any of the musicians around here have a drink?

Around here? Uh huh. Oh. Man. Drink. Used to drink myself. That's the only way I could play. Drink. Yeah. That's the only way I could play. To drink. If I didn't have nothing to drink. That was it. I remember when I was playing to the Lovito. I used to go to work every night with a quarter whiskey. Every night. To have a quarter whiskey. I bought so much whiskey at the Waldorf drugstore. Until I wouldn't have to tell the man what I want. When they see me come to sleep.
come in to do it, grab the bottle and wrap it up. Give it to me. Get it all credit, I didn't have no money all the time. Get it all credit. Pee him when I get off.
